findings.text: non-blocking: the build-seam control's pass condition is `SEAM` being non-zero (resolve.sh:50-51 and the SEAM==0 refusal at :70), which any crash satisfies, and in the actual cohort run it was satisfied by a FileNotFoundError in benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:675 reading docs/figures/diiid-forward-onboarding/current-polarity/current_polarity_audit_receipt.json (resolve-977fce96.log tail), not by the adapter's refusal; the refusal evidence is the separate job 1335481 in control-977fce96.log, so the in-cohort arm does not itself demonstrate the control and a future crash would read as a pass.

non-blocking: record_solved_currents reads kwargs["shipped_current_a"], so a caller that passes the adapter's fifth argument positionally raises KeyError inside the receipt hook and loses the solve record; the benchmark's current call sites pass it by keyword, so the run succeeded, but the hook is coupled to a calling convention it does not check.

non-blocking: no test exercises install_corpus_correction's shift loop, carries_currents or column_shifts aggregation, so deleting or mis-scaling the column write at :116 would leave the whole 12-test suite green and be caught only by re-running the four-arm cohort.
